description: Use when you must check an email address before sending, signing up a user or adding a lead: syntax (IDN-aware), MX records with A/AAAA fallback, null MX, and disposable, role (info@, sales@). Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /v1/email/verify, $0.01 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Checks one mailbox; for a list use check_email_batch; for a whole domain (DNS, SPF, DMARC) use domain_report. With a P0 access key (header Authorization: Bearer p0k_…, buy one at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) this tool makes the paid call itself and returns the data, deducting the listed price.
